changes: SMPL WAVEFORM shows one row of values (TUN, RATE, BR, LOP, LEV) over a taller waveform: one new site in the SAMPLE view's knob loop (0x400d20ee) calls stock's knob-text routine with the row's place and the value shown, and draws a locked value's box itself; the widget's area in the view's RAM moves from 16/32 to 10/37. While the widget's sample slot reads 0, the module runs stock's page callback (0x400d253a) again every 8 UI ticks, so the waveform appears once the sample has loaded after boot.
stockPolicy: No firmware or stock-derived code/tables are present. Addresses, lengths and SHA-256 guards are metadata; exported instructions and sections are authored module code. Local materialized recipes and firmware are never committed.
